notes:
- Added WooCommerce order filters and optional customer details for connections with account read access. Orders omit customer details by default.
- Improved product search and detail lookup, account filters, and inventory of available plugin and theme updates.
- Added a separate permission to disclose full account email addresses. Email addresses are masked by default.
- Added dry-run previews for up to 20 account deletions. Each actual deletion still requires owner approval.
- Expanded inspection and editing for supported editorial content types and Flatsome UX Blocks, and added SEOPress metadata support.
- Improved capability discovery, proposal summaries, and error messages.
- Added PHP syntax checks for maintenance uploads and edits, protected sensitive files and options on direct reads, and required separate owner approval for unrestricted PHP, SQL, and WP-CLI operations even in Full access mode.
